name: Femboy & Futa: Stay a Little Longer
source: A story-rich adult visual novel set in a cozy café after dark. Work the late shift, handle unexpected challenges, and grow closer to Milo and Ren through playful banter, quiet confessions, and intimate moments before the café closes its doors for good.
translation: 一部剧情丰富的成人向视觉小说，故事发生在夜幕降临后一家温馨舒适的咖啡馆里。在咖啡馆永久歇业之前，值守晚班、应对突如其来的挑战，并在嬉笑打趣、轻声倾诉与亲密温存间，拉近与米洛和莲的距离。
